edits.with:
<style id="ax-s138">
/* s138: the Timing strip in Recall. Each dot's place on the axis repeats the masked "when" (the Differential's
   Decides-it timing), so in Recall the strip drops its axis, stems and dots and lists the events, each "when" masked
   (runbook section 3: mask the repeat, never delete it). */
body.study .brief.sp .sp-on-ax{display:none}
body.study .brief.sp .sp-on-f{height:auto}
body.study .brief.sp .sp-on-ev > li{position:static;left:auto;bottom:auto;width:auto;height:auto;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
body.study .brief.sp .sp-on-ev > li:first-child{border-top:0}
body.study .brief.sp .sp-on-ev > li::before,body.study .brief.sp .sp-on-ev > li::after{display:none}
body.study .brief.sp .sp-on-ev > li > div{position:static;transform:none;max-width:none;padding:0;background:none;box-shadow:none}
body.study .brief.sp .sp-on-ev > li > div > *{white-space:normal}
</style>
</head>
edits.note: s138 Recall: the Timing strip lists its events with each "when" masked (display review MED, ssri-effects and antipsych-effects round 1)
